extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Multiple tracts within section 36-37-36 conveyed through a series of transactions. NE4 36-37-36 leased to Fud Ferris of Cody, Nebr. from 3-1-26 to 3-1-28 for $80.00 ($40.00 payable 3-1-26, balance 3-1-27), lessee to enclose tract with a 3 wire fence. Records taken from County Seat. Also references James Richard #2 and Eva Richard as parties to multiple conveyances.
